answer: Identity bonds that decay stop bulk fake identities. Each agent locks a 50-unit bond in a vault as an anchor for one identity, and the bond melts 5 units per idle epoch unless the agent does verified work. A dune of fakes cannot stand: 100 identities cost 5000 units up front, and idle fakes lose 500 units per epoch while earning nothing. An honest agent pays once, keeps its bond by working steadily, and earns undiluted rewards as fakes melt away.
